newsitem.title: USA: Bellwether names Sere as new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Bellwether names Sere as new chairman.

text.p: Bellwether Exploration Co said Friday that its chairman J.P. Bryan is retiring effective today, and that president and chief executive Darby Sere will become the company's new chairman.
It said Bryan will remain on the board as a non-executive member. Bryan is also retiring as chairman and chief executive at Torch Energy Advisors, an employee-owned company also based in Houston.
Bellwether said Bryan's decision to retire will allow him to focus more time on the day-to-day operations of Gulf Canada Resources Limited, where he is currently president and CEO.
Torch Energy said Doug Foshee, its president and chief operating officer since May 1995, will become chief executive effective immediately.
